# CONF-015: stdio: stdout carries only newline-delimited JSON-RPC messages

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| error | both eras, stdio | [2026-07-28/basic/transports/stdio#stdio](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports/stdio#stdio) |

Inspects every line the server wrote to stdout during the suite. The server MUST NOT write anything to stdout that is not a valid MCP message, and messages are newline-delimited. Logging belongs on stderr. 2025-11-25 states the same rules (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/basic/transports#stdio). On servers that speak both eras it runs twice: once with modern requests, and once inside a legacy initialize session as <ID>@legacy.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain CONF-015`. To leave it out of a run, add `"CONF-015"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
